#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build an optimized release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cabal update
cabal build exe:app
cp "$(cabal list-bin exe:app)" ./app.tmp
mv -f ./app.tmp ./app

{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}

module Main (main) where

import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp qualified as Warp
import System.Environment (getArgs, getProgName)
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr)
import Text.Read (readMaybe)

import KvHttp (application, newStore)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  args <- getArgs
  case args of
    [p] | Just port <- readMaybe p, port > 0, port < 65536 -> serve port
    _ -> do
      name <- getProgName
      hPutStrLn stderr ("usage: " <> name <> " <port>")
      exitFailure

serve :: Int -> IO ()
serve port = do
  store <- newStore
  let settings =
        Warp.setHost "127.0.0.1" $
          Warp.setPort port Warp.defaultSettings
  Warp.runSettings settings (application store)

cabal-version:   3.4
name:            kvhttp
version:         0.1.0.0
synopsis:        In-memory HTTP key-value server
build-type:      Simple

common common
    default-language: GHC2024
    ghc-options: -Wall -Wcompat -Widentities -Wredundant-constraints
                 -Wpartial-fields -Wmissing-deriving-strategies -Wunused-packages
    build-depends: base ^>=4.22

library
    import:          common
    hs-source-dirs:  src
    exposed-modules: KvHttp
                     KvHttp.Store
    build-depends:   bytestring ^>=0.12,
                     containers ^>=0.8,
                     http-types >=0.12 && <0.13,
                     wai >=3.2 && <3.3

executable app
    import:         common
    hs-source-dirs: exe
    main-is:        Main.hs
    ghc-options:    -O2 -threaded -rtsopts "-with-rtsopts=-N"
    build-depends:  kvhttp,
                    warp >=3.3 && <3.5

{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}

-- | HTTP routing for the key-value server.
module KvHttp
  ( application
  , isValidKey
  , module KvHttp.Store
  ) where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as BS
import Data.ByteString.Builder (Builder)
import Data.ByteString.Builder qualified as B
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as BC
import Data.ByteString.Lazy qualified as BL
import Data.List (intersperse)
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Network.Wai

import KvHttp.Store

data Route
  = Health
  | KeyList
  | KeyItem ByteString
  | BadKey
  | NoRoute

route :: ByteString -> Route
route path = case path of
  "/health" -> Health
  "/kv" -> KeyList
  _ | Just key <- BS.stripPrefix "/kv/" path ->
        if isValidKey key then KeyItem key else BadKey
    | otherwise -> NoRoute

-- | A key matches @[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}@.
isValidKey :: ByteString -> Bool
isValidKey k = not (BS.null k) && BS.length k <= 64 && BC.all keyChar k
  where
    keyChar c =
      (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
        || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')
        || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
        || c == '_'
        || c == '-'

application :: Store -> Application
application store req respond =
  case (route (rawPathInfo req), parseMethod (requestMethod req)) of
    (Health, Right GET) -> respond $ plain status200 "ok"
    (Health, _) -> respond methodNotAllowed
    (KeyList, Right GET) -> do
      keys <- listKeys store
      respond $ bytes status200 "application/json" (BL.toStrict (B.toLazyByteString (jsonArray keys)))
    (KeyList, _) -> respond methodNotAllowed
    (KeyItem key, Right GET) ->
      getValue store key >>= \case
        Just v -> respond $ bytes status200 "application/octet-stream" v
        Nothing -> respond notFound
    (KeyItem key, Right PUT) -> do
      body <- BL.toStrict <$> strictRequestBody req
      putValue store key body >>= \case
        Created -> respond $ empty status201
        Replaced -> respond $ empty status200
    (KeyItem key, Right DELETE) -> do
      deleted <- deleteValue store key
      respond $ if deleted then empty status204 else notFound
    (KeyItem _, _) -> respond methodNotAllowed
    (BadKey, _) -> respond $ plain status400 "invalid key"
    (NoRoute, _) -> respond notFound
  where
    plain s = bytes s "text/plain"
    empty s = responseLBS s [(hContentLength, "0")] ""
    notFound = plain status404 "not found"
    methodNotAllowed = plain status405 "method not allowed"

-- | A response with an explicit @Content-Length@, so Warp never falls back to
-- chunked transfer encoding.
bytes :: Status -> ByteString -> ByteString -> Response
bytes s contentType body =
  responseLBS
    s
    [ (hContentType, contentType)
    , (hContentLength, BC.pack (show (BS.length body)))
    ]
    (BL.fromStrict body)

-- | Keys are restricted to JSON-safe characters, so no escaping is needed.
jsonArray :: [ByteString] -> Builder
jsonArray keys =
  B.char7 '[' <> mconcat (intersperse (B.char7 ',') (map quote keys)) <> B.char7 ']'
  where
    quote k = B.char7 '"' <> B.byteString k <> B.char7 '"'

-- | A thread-safe, in-memory key-value store.
module KvHttp.Store
  ( Store
  , PutResult (..)
  , newStore
  , putValue
  , getValue
  , deleteValue
  , listKeys
  ) where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.IORef (IORef, atomicModifyIORef', newIORef, readIORef)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map

newtype Store = Store (IORef (Map ByteString ByteString))

data PutResult = Created | Replaced
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

newStore :: IO Store
newStore = Store <$> newIORef Map.empty

-- | Insert or replace a value, reporting which happened.
putValue :: Store -> ByteString -> ByteString -> IO PutResult
putValue (Store ref) key value =
  atomicModifyIORef' ref $ \m ->
    let (old, m') = Map.insertLookupWithKey (\_ new _ -> new) key value m
     in (m', maybe Created (const Replaced) old)

getValue :: Store -> ByteString -> IO (Maybe ByteString)
getValue (Store ref) key = Map.lookup key <$> readIORef ref

-- | Delete a key, returning whether it was present.
deleteValue :: Store -> ByteString -> IO Bool
deleteValue (Store ref) key =
  atomicModifyIORef' ref $ \m ->
    case Map.updateLookupWithKey (\_ _ -> Nothing) key m of
      (Just _, m') -> (m', True)
      (Nothing, _) -> (m, False)

-- | All keys in ascending order.
listKeys :: Store -> IO [ByteString]
listKeys (Store ref) = Map.keys <$> readIORef ref
